title: About
description: The musical journey of Mikaël Stroobants, creator of Expedition Creativity.
heading:
Behind every expedition.
A storyteller.
lead: Expedition Creativity is the personal creative hub of Mikaël Stroobants: cinematic music, orchestral storytelling and imaginative journeys inspired by nature, adventure and film music.

sections.title: My musical journey
sections.body:
My musical journey began with the French horn, an instrument that taught me how melody, breath and colour can shape emotion.

For 15 years, I played in a local band. That experience taught me discipline, ensemble playing, live performance and the joy of creating something bigger together.

At the same time, my passion for film music kept growing. Composers like John Williams, Hans Zimmer, James Newton Howard, Harry Gregson-Williams and Howard Shore showed me how music can build entire worlds.

Expedition Creativity brings those influences together. Every track starts from a scene, a feeling or a question, and grows into a small cinematic expedition.

sections.title: Creative Compass
sections.body:
Film Music

Orchestral storytelling inspired by cinematic composers and emotional world-building.

Adventure

Each release is shaped like a journey, with its own landscape, characters and atmosphere.

Imagination

A place for wonder, curiosity and music that invites listeners to explore beyond the obvious.
